An '''iron hoe''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]], crafted from [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. It mines at speed 8 and has 500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_hoe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines hoe blocks at speed 8 (vanilla: 6).

In Matcha Flavoured, hoes also mine wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 1 damage with an attack speed of 3.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>
